svg.title: Amylin weight-loss drugs: where each one stands
svg.desc: Amylin weight-loss drugs: where each one stands. Pramlintide (Symlin), AstraZeneca: Approved only for diabetes, alongside mealtime insulin. Boxed warning: severe low blood sugar. Status: Approved, not for weight. CagriSema (cagrilintide + semaglutide), Novo: Phase 3 done; filed with FDA December 2025. Novo expects a decision in Q4 2026. Status: Under FDA review. Cagrilintide alone, Novo: Phase 3 RENEW trials; first main results estimated May 2027 (registry). Status: Phase 3. Eloralintide, Lilly: Phase 2 in 263 people published. 7 phase 3 trials; first estimated done January 2028. Status: Phase 3. Petrelintide, Zealand and Roche: Two phase 2 trials (one peer reviewed). Phase 3 began Sep 2026; results est. late 2028. Status: Phase 3 just started. Amycretin, Novo: Amylin and GLP-1 in one molecule. First phase 3 results due mid-2028 (see our teardown). Status: Phase 3. Long-term safety, whole class: Longest placebo-controlled amylin data: 68 weeks. No outcomes trial has reported. Status: Unknown.
